## Dollar Tree, Inc. to Host Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call


November 19, 2025 6:30am EST[Download as PDF](https://corporate.dollartree.com/_assets/_49e04488fca5c18db272d83f52b897ff/dollartreeinfo/news/2025-11-19_Dollar_Tree_Inc_to_Host_Third_Quarter_Earnings_299.pdf)


CHESAPEAKE, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Dollar Tree, Inc. (NASDAQ: DLTR), will report financial results for the third quarter 2025 ended November 1, 2025, before the stock market opens on Wednesday, December 3, 2025, followed by a conference call for investors and analysts at 8 a.m. EST. Chief Executive Officer Mike Creedon and Chief Financial Officer Stewart Glendinning will discuss the company’s results and lead a question-and-answer session.


WHEN:


Wednesday, December 3, 2025


8 a.m. Eastern Time


DIAL-IN:


Please dial (877) 407-3943 or (201) 689-8855 at least 10 minutes prior to the scheduled start time.


WEBCAST:


Available on the investor relations section of the company's website at[https://corporate.dollartree.com/investors/news-events/ir-calendar](https://corporate.dollartree.com/investors/news-events/ir-calendar) .


REPLAY:


A recorded version of the call will be accessible approximately three hours after the completion of the call by dialing (877) 660-6853 or (201) 612-7415 and entering the passcode 13756945. The replay will be available for seven days after the call.
